snippet.title: Terraria: Spirit Reforged | Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Releases Friday, March 21st, 2025.

It’s a huge day for Spirit! We have some news for you: After 9 years of development, we’re taking big steps forward into our next adventure! We are so excited to present the trailer for our next Terraria mod out to you all!

Spirit Reforged is Team Spirit’s new modded project and our main priority. It is a remastered version of the best the original Spirit Mod had to offer and much more. This update, you can look forward to new items, weapons, biomes, and NPCs! Reforged can be played in Singleplayer or Multiplayer.

To learn more, join our Discord! https://discord.gg/013k6H2ufdQjco5kv
